items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: I learned clarinet from my brother, Neil.

ctx.x: What instrument was Theo teaching you? I mean, clarinet or saxophone or, uh?
I learned clarinet from my brother, Neil. Oh, oh. But what I, what, the relative Theo should, taught me and gave me some of the ideas on saxophone.
When you started playing, I mean, did you, did your playing, did it favor anybody else, do you think, or?
